newsitem.title: USA: US WEST COAST CRUDE PRICES RISE, BUYING DRIES UP - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: US WEST COAST CRUDE PRICES RISE, BUYING DRIES UP - AUG 13.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices tracked strong gains in energy futures Wednesday with traders claiming the market for September deliveries of Alaskan crude was finished.
BP Oil, a main Alaska North Slopre (ANS) crude seller, remained out of the market this week while traders attended corporate meetings in Ohio.

Demand fell after two refiners bought spot barrels of ANS last week and several other did formula deals, leaving the market $1.97 a barrel under benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing crude, traders said.
The discount, which has shrunk since a mid-June cargo sold at minus $2.08, is expected to hold steady for the rest of the month.
Kern River and Wilmington grades were flat Wednesday after rising with postings the day before.
